body: We detected unauthorized use of an OAuth service token at approximately 03:15 UTC today. The token could access Northstar Learning analytics exports. We disabled it at 07:10 UTC. Our preliminary query indicates roughly 18,000 records; scope and start time remain under review.
subject: Security incident notification - Cobalt Metrics

body: Forwarding the vendor alert. Treat 03:15 as preliminary; we do not yet know whether it is first access, detection, or confirmation. Incident bridge opens at 08:30 UTC.
subject: Escalation: Cobalt token compromise

body: The tenant ledger reconciles to 18,420 affected rows: 4,860 EEA, 12,940 United States, and 620 Canada. The fields were name, email, organization ID, product-usage events, and support content. No payment card, password, government ID, or Social Security number fields are present in this export.
subject: Exact export reconciliation

body: Preserve vendor communications, cloud audit logs, token configuration, affected export manifests, and incident-room messages. body: Correction to our initial alert: retained OAuth logs show first suspicious use at 02:58 UTC on 8 September, not 03:15. The analyst escalated at 03:15, we confirmed unauthorized access at 05:30, and disabled the token at 07:10. Export activity may extend back to 16:04 UTC on 29 August. Logs for 29-30 August are incomplete; the currently supported activity window is 29 August 16:04 through 8 September 07:10 UTC.
subject: Forensic update 1 - corrected event times
